text:
tiffany: Heads-up - PR #2456 (sdk-snippets) preview failed in CI. markdown-lint errors (MD034: bare URL), link-checker 404 on an internal guide, and spellcheck flagged 'onnboard' (should be 'onboard').

ci-bot: CI summary for PR #2456:
- markdown-lint: 2 errors (MD034, MD022)
- linkcheck: 1 broken link -> /guides/v1/serve.md (404)
- spellcheck: 1 suggestion -> 'onnboard' -> 'onboard'
- preview build: failed during snippet bundling

jonathan: Ugh. Should we pause reviewers while we triage? I can hold the review queue if needed.

samir: I can take the fix. Looks like the link points to the old guides path (/guides/v1). This PR is moving snippets around so I probably broke it. I'll correct the link, fix the typo, and re-run preview.

tiffany: Thanks. @samir please add a short note in the commit message about the path change so backports are easier. Also, tag @kevin for review once CI is clean.

maria: FYI @kevin is on docs duty today. If it's quick we can avoid a full hold.

kevin: pinged — will review after CI passes. :thumbsup:

samir: pushing a tiny patch now. commit message: "docs(snippets): fix broken guide link -> /guides/serve.md, correct 'onnboard' typo"

docs-bot: Preview redeployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/pr-2456 (renders on netlify-style preview).

ci-bot: Re-run results:
- markdown-lint: 1 warning (MD022 line length)
- linkcheck: OK
- spellcheck: OK
- preview build: succeeded

jonathan: Nice. What's left?

samir: Vale surfaced a stylistic warning: "avoid weasel words" in the intro paragraph. It's a minor wording change. Do we want to address it pre-merge or as a follow-up?

tiffany: Let's fix it here to keep the CI clean. Small wording tweak.

samir: Done. pushed change: "tighten intro wording to remove weasel phrase"

ci-bot: Final run: all checks passed ✅

kevin: Reviewing now. Quick pass looks good. One nit in an example that doesn't affect output; I'll leave it as a suggestion in the review.

tiffany: Thanks everyone. LGTM from docs side — merging once protected branch windows opens (in ~5m).

jonathan: :party-parrot: Nice turnaround.

samir: Thanks — noted the reviewer nit as a follow-up issue.

docs-bot: PR #2456 merged into main by tiffany. Changelog updated.
